prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear quarter panel and passenger-side rear door show scraping, a creased edge along the lower body line, and paint transfer consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. The damage pattern matches the impact as described by the insured. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file or from the inspection. Labor hours for panel straightening, refinishing, and blending fit the extent of the damage. Two similar charges on the same day are under review and will be confirmed before the estimate is finalized. The repair plan is to replace the rear door skin, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and recheck alignment of the adjacent trim before release.
